method: Google Places API (New) searchText priceLevel for each unpriced listing, matched on name and address, high or medium confidence only, mapped PRICE_LEVEL_INEXPENSIVE=$, MODERATE=$$, EXPENSIVE=$$$, VERY_EXPENSIVE=$$$$. Places Google reports closed, low-confidence or rejected matches, and places with no priceLevel stay unpriced. Owner-supplied tiers are recorded with source Augusto; Google per-person price lines use Augusto's rule (under $20 $, $20-50 $$, $50-100 $$$, $100+ $$$$). No estimates.
